title: The Sunday Read: ‘I Fell in Love With Motorcycles. But Could I Ever Love Sturgis?’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报 DealBook 报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Jamie Lauren Kalis.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫杰米·劳伦·卡利斯。

sentences.en: I'm a contributing writer for the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》杂志的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: This story is about my trip to the Sturgis Motorcycle Rally in Sturgis, South Dakota.
sentences.zh: 这篇报道关于我前往南达科他州斯特吉斯参加斯特吉斯摩托车拉力赛的经历。

sentences.en: So I bought my motorcycle back in May of 2021, and I was mainly looking for a form of transportation.
sentences.zh: 我在2021年5月买了摩托车，当时主要是为了找一种代步工具。

sentences.en: In the first weeks after I picked up the motorcycle, I was really surprised at how my friends received it.
sentences.zh: 刚买摩托车的那几周，朋友们的反应让我非常惊讶。

sentences.en: I thought I was just like, oh, riding from my house to a party.
sentences.zh: 我当时想的只是，哦，骑车从家去参加聚会而已。

sentences.en: And then I'd show up at the party and people would come outside and say,
sentences.zh: 然后当我骑到聚会现场，人们会走出来说：

sentences.en: OK, bad boy, like, let me get a ride on that hog.
sentences.zh: “嘿，坏小子，让我骑骑你的那辆‘大块头’吧。”

sentences.en: And I didn't really think that, like, people really believed in that type of motorcycle outlaw actually existing.
sentences.zh: 我以前真没觉得那种摩托车“亡命之徒”的形象真的存在。

sentences.en: To me, it seemed like something from a cartoon or something you saw, like maybe in a movie from the 80s.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那看起来像是卡通片里的东西，或者像是在80年代电影里看到的那样。

sentences.en: But the fact that not only it existed, but now suddenly I found myself within it was just shocking.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，它不仅存在，而且我突然发现自己身处其中，这简直太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: I was a little nervous going out to Sturgis, to be honest, because I thought initially that this outlaw archetype didn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，去斯特吉斯的时候我有点紧张，因为我最初认为这种“亡命之徒”的原型并不存在。

sentences.en: But then as I got taste of it back in New York, I was like, maybe it really does exist and I'm going to the heart of it and Sturgis is going to be really dangerous.
sentences.zh: 但当我在纽约初尝这种滋味后，我就想，也许它真的存在，而我正要深入其核心，斯特吉斯可能会非常危险。

sentences.en: I don't know, that's like embarrassing to say now, because when I got there,
sentences.zh: 我不知道，现在说出来有点尴尬，因为当我到达那里时，

sentences.en: it was really just this place where people could go and have a fantasy of themselves as something a little bit cooler or a little bit more hardcore than what they might be on the day to day.
sentences.zh: 那其实只是一个人们可以去的地方，让他们幻想自己比日常生活中看起来更酷、更硬核一点。

sentences.en: So I came out of it with a little bit of a new openness towards being a sexy bad boy on a motorcycle,
sentences.zh: 所以我从中获得了一种新的开放心态，去接受做一个骑摩托车的性感坏小子，

sentences.en: which is something I didn't think I was setting out to do when I started this journey.
sentences.zh: 这在我开始这段旅程时是完全没想到的。

sentences.en: So here's my article.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的文章。

sentences.en: In order to join one of the private Facebook groups for the 81st annual Sturgis Motorcycle Rally, I had to agree to 10 rules.
sentences.zh: 为了加入第81届年度斯特吉斯摩托车拉力赛的私人 Facebook 群组之一，我必须同意10条规则。

sentences.en: Seven addressed matters of basic netiquette.
sentences.zh: 其中七条涉及基本的网络礼仪。

sentences.en: Respect, courtesy, bullying, privacy, solicitation, both kinds.
sentences.zh: 尊重、礼貌、禁止霸凌、隐私、禁止拉客，各种形式的都不行。

sentences.en: Two were apolitical in ways that felt extremely political.
sentences.zh: 有两条规则表面上不涉及政治，但感觉却极其政治化。

sentences.en: No COVID comments and absolutely no politics.
sentences.zh: 禁止发表关于新冠的评论，绝对禁止谈论政治。

sentences.en: You will be deleted.
sentences.zh: 违者将被删除。

sentences.en: The last concerned what is known as trailering or towing your motorcycle out to Sturgis.
sentences.zh: 最后一条涉及所谓的“拖车”，即把摩托车拖到斯特吉斯。

sentences.en: No trailer bashing, the rule proclaimed.
sentences.zh: 规则宣称：禁止抨击拖车行为。

sentences.en: You will be removed.
sentences.zh: 违者将被移除。

sentences.en: Trailering is a common way to get to Sturgis, South Dakota, though it is generally considered the least respectable.
sentences.zh: 拖车是前往南达科他州斯特吉斯的常见方式，尽管它通常被认为是最不体面的。

sentences.en: The most esteemed way to arrive at America's legendary motorcycle rally is by riding there, from your house, on your own bike.
sentences.zh: 参加美国传奇摩托车拉力赛最受推崇的方式，是骑着你自己的摩托车从家里一路骑过去。

sentences.en: An attitude evinced by the glut of merchandise, proclaiming, I rode mine, Sturgis 21.
sentences.zh: 这种态度体现在大量的周边商品上，上面写着：“我骑我自己的车，斯特吉斯 21”。

sentences.en: One subcurrent at Sturgis, as I would soon discover, is raiding who is and is not a real biker.
sentences.zh: 正如我很快就会发现的，斯特吉斯的一个潜流是评判谁是真正的骑手，谁不是。

sentences.en: Trailers, renters, three-wheeling trikers, members of outlaw gangs, women.
sentences.zh: 拖车族、租车族、骑三轮摩托的、亡命帮派成员、女性。

sentences.en: There is no one true answer to this question, but there are a lot of slogans making one case or another.
sentences.zh: 这个问题没有唯一的标准答案，但有很多口号在支持这样或那样的观点。

sentences.en: It goes without saying that there aren't t-shirts for people who fly in from Newark and rent a bike.
sentences.zh: 不用说，那些从纽瓦克飞过来租车骑的人是没有T恤可穿的。

sentences.en: United Flight 3533 to Rapid City, South Dakota was nearly 100% white couples of retirement age.
sentences.zh: 飞往南达科他州拉皮德城的联合航空 3533 号航班上，几乎全是退休年龄的白人夫妇。

sentences.en: Economy round trip cost about $700, and boarding had that hail, key-party-ish vibe of flights where everyone is on vacation.
sentences.zh: 经济舱往返票价约700美元，登机时有一种那种大家都在度假的航班特有的喧闹和派对氛围。

sentences.en: The wives, in expensive flip-flops and cheap leggings, discussed past trips to Caribbean resorts.
sentences.zh: 妻子们穿着昂贵的人字拖和廉价的紧身裤，讨论着过去去加勒比海度假村的旅行。

sentences.en: The husbands checked weather apps on their phones.
sentences.zh: 丈夫们则在手机上查看天气预报。

sentences.en: As I loaded my bag into the overhead bin, two couples noticed they were in each other's seats.
sentences.zh: 当我把包放进头顶行李架时，两对夫妇发现他们坐错了对方的座位。

sentences.en: Want to switch?
sentences.zh: “要换一下吗？”

sentences.en: said one wife to the other.
sentences.zh: 一位妻子对另一位说。

sentences.en: I'll sit with your husband.
sentences.zh: “我和你丈夫坐。”

sentences.en: Did she wink?
sentences.zh: 她刚才眨眼了吗？

sentences.en: From my seat in row 19, the cabin appeared as a series of horizons, each with its own dim-setting sun.
sentences.zh: 从我第19排的座位看去，机舱就像是一系列的地平线，每一排都有自己昏暗的落日。

sentences.en: The Bicball dome and noise-canceling headphones, or the mesh-backed baseball cap with the little semi-circle of salt-and-pepper thatching sticking out the back.
sentences.zh: 棒球帽和降噪耳机，或者那种后部带有半圆网眼、露出一点灰白头发的棒球帽。

sentences.en: Behind me, two couples claimed all of row 20.
sentences.zh: 在我身后，两对夫妇占了第20排的所有座位。

sentences.en: Husbands in the windows, wives on the aisles, passing a bag of candy back and forth.
sentences.zh: 丈夫靠窗，妻子靠过道，互相传递着一袋糖果。

sentences.en: I wonder if I should put on my Trump hat, one wife said.
sentences.zh: “我在想我是不是该戴上我的特朗普帽子，”一位妻子说。

sentences.en: I better not say that too loud, she said louder.
sentences.zh: “我最好别说得太大声，”她又大声说道。

sentences.en: No, the other wife reassured her.
sentences.zh: “没关系，”另一位妻子安慰她。

sentences.en: These are all bikers.
sentences.zh: “这些都是骑手。”

sentences.en: They like Trump.
sentences.zh: “他们喜欢特朗普。”

sentences.en: She spoke in a tone of mischief, not confrontation.
sentences.zh: 她说话的语气带着调皮，而不是对抗。

sentences.en: The, oh, you're bad, of the third margarita.
sentences.zh: 就像喝了第三杯玛格丽特酒后那种“哦，你真坏”的感觉。

sentences.en: Everyone was in the outlaw spirit, preparing to hit the open road in the lawless territory where Wild Bill Hickok was shot, a state with no adult helmet laws.
sentences.zh: 每个人都沉浸在亡命之徒的精神中，准备在狂野比尔·希科克被枪杀的法外之地，在一个没有成人头盔法的州，踏上开阔的道路。

sentences.en: Since the first Harley-Davidson was sold in 1903, the motorcycle in America has intertwined itself with the two types of liberty.
sentences.zh: 自1903年第一辆哈雷戴维森售出以来，美国的摩托车就与两种自由交织在一起。

sentences.en: Freedom to, wander, skip town, enjoy life.
sentences.zh: 去往的自由：漫游、远走高飞、享受生活。

sentences.en: And freedom from, the mainstream, the desk job, social mores.
sentences.zh: 以及摆脱的自由：摆脱主流、摆脱办公室工作、摆脱社会习俗。

sentences.en: These tensions reconcile in all sorts of biker cultures.
sentences.zh: 这些张力在各种骑手文化中得到了调和。

sentences.en: The urban dirt biker, the cafe racing yuppie.
sentences.zh: 城市越野骑手、咖啡骑士雅皮士。

sentences.en: But Sturdas is unique in selling the fantasy of a subculture based on the dominant one.
sentences.zh: 但斯特吉斯独特之处在于，它兜售的是一种基于主流文化的亚文化幻想。

sentences.en: Here, middle-aged riders of $20,000 American-made motorcycles gather for 10 days of controlled rebellion to wander paved roads, buy Harley merchandise,
sentences.zh: 在这里，骑着价值2万美元美国制造摩托车的中年骑手们聚集在一起，进行为期10天的受控叛逆，在铺好的道路上漫游，购买哈雷周边，

sentences.en: and rage against the reality of their milieu's waning cultural relevance.
sentences.zh: 并对他们所处环境的文化相关性日益衰减的现实感到愤怒。

sentences.en: The mood of rebellion felt doubly high in light of the whole pandemic situation.
sentences.zh: 鉴于整个疫情形势，这种叛逆的情绪显得格外高涨。

sentences.en: According to research published in the Southern Economic Journal, the 2020 Sturgis Rally,
sentences.zh: 根据《南方经济学杂志》发表的研究，2020年的斯特吉斯拉力赛，

sentences.en: the largest public gathering to take place in the country since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic,
sentences.zh: 自新冠疫情开始以来全国最大的公共集会，

sentences.en: was responsible for between 115,283 and 266,796 new COVID cases nationwide, generating up to an estimated $8.7 billion in health care costs.
sentences.zh: 导致全国范围内新增了115,283至266,796例新冠病例，估计产生了高达87亿美元的医疗成本。

sentences.en: This year already, the media was warning of the four bikers of the apocalypse.
sentences.zh: 今年，媒体已经在警告“末日的四位骑手”了。

sentences.en: Like many other Americans, I bought my first motorcycle during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 像许多其他美国人一样，我在疫情期间买了我的第一辆摩托车。

sentences.en: I thought I was just purchasing a mode of transportation, a way to get around without riding the train,
sentences.zh: 我以为我只是买了一种交通工具，一种不用坐火车就能四处走动的方式，

sentences.en: but after some time on the street with other riders, I started to suspect I'd signed up for a lot more.
sentences.zh: 但在街上和其他骑手相处一段时间后，我开始怀疑我签下的远不止这些。

sentences.en: Obviously, I was aware of biker culture, but somehow I decided that these tropes—choppers, leather jackets, the whole deal—were all but contentless by now.
sentences.zh: 显然，我知道骑手文化，但不知何故，我认定这些比喻——机车、皮夹克，所有这些——现在已经毫无内涵了。

sentences.en: Mere tchotchkes on the wall in the TGI Fridays of American Individualism.
sentences.zh: 不过是美国个人主义连锁餐厅墙上的装饰品而已。

sentences.en: Imagine my shock upon discovering, not only did this strain of biker culture still exist, but that I existed within it.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，当我发现这种骑手文化不仅依然存在，而且我竟然身处其中时，我是多么震惊。

sentences.en: At first, I felt embarrassed to find myself complicit in a myth so overbaked.
sentences.zh: 起初，我对自己竟然参与了这样一个陈词滥调的神话感到尴尬。

sentences.en: Eventually, I became curious about what might still be vital at its heart.
sentences.zh: 最终，我开始好奇它的核心还有什么依然是有活力的。

sentences.en: This is the feeling that sent me off to Sturgis.
sentences.zh: 正是这种感觉让我踏上了前往斯特吉斯的旅程。

sentences.en: Up in the sky at cruising altitude, I got up and took a walk to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 在巡航高度的空中，我起身去洗手间。

sentences.en: Outlaws munched on Biscoff cookies.
sentences.zh: “亡命之徒”们正在嚼着饼干。

sentences.en: A grown man snoozed across two seats in his socks.
sentences.zh: 一个成年男人穿着袜子横躺在两个座位上打盹。

sentences.en: Somewhere near row 18, a flight attendant admonished another passenger to pull his mask over his nose.
sentences.zh: 在第18排附近，一名空乘人员告诫另一名乘客把口罩拉过鼻子。

sentences.en: He pulled it up high, then pulled it up higher, covering his whole face for a selfie.
sentences.zh: 他把口罩拉高，然后拉得更高，遮住整张脸自拍。

sentences.en: The flight attendant moved along.
sentences.zh: 空乘人员走开了。

sentences.en: He pulled it back down.
sentences.zh: 他又把它拉了下来。

sentences.en: My motorcycle journey started in May 2019, when Revel, an app-based urban mobility startup, dumped a few hundred electronic mopeds into the gentrified regions of the Outer Burrows.
sentences.zh: 我的摩托车之旅始于2019年5月，当时一家基于应用程序的城市出行初创公司 Revel，在外围行政区的绅士化地区投放了几百辆电动轻便摩托车。

sentences.en: At the time, I was living in Queens, a half-mile outside the rental radius.
sentences.zh: 当时我住在皇后区，距离租赁范围半英里远。

sentences.en: Despite some vague sense that the scooters were bad, that they might represent creeping privatization in the lead-up to an infrastructure crisis, or something,
sentences.zh: 尽管有一种模糊的感觉，认为这些滑板车不好，它们可能代表了基础设施危机前夕的渐进式私有化，或者类似的东西，

sentences.en: I soon found myself taking furtive strolls down into the app's coverage zone.
sentences.zh: 但我很快发现自己偷偷溜进了该应用程序的覆盖区域。

sentences.en: The Revels were humiliating to ride, with the sexless body style of a chase ATM, and yet I was hooked on the frictionlessness of traversing a gridlock city on two wheels.
sentences.zh: 骑 Revel 很丢人，因为它的车身造型像一台自动取款机，毫无美感，但我却迷上了在拥堵的城市里骑着两轮车穿梭的顺畅感。

sentences.en: One day on my walk down into the zone, I came across a guy in a garage with a whole herd of vintage mopeds for sale.
sentences.zh: 有一天，当我走进那个区域时，我偶然发现一个车库里的人在卖一大堆复古轻便摩托车。

sentences.en: Closing the Revel app for the last time, I withdrew $500 from an ATM and rode off that day on a 1980 Moto B-Cane Mobilette.
sentences.zh: 我最后一次关闭了 Revel 应用程序，从自动取款机里取了500美元，那天就骑着一辆1980年的 Moto B-Cane Mobilette 走了。

sentences.en: My Mobilette had a rakish red frame and an extra-long black leather seat with space for a girl with a scarf around her neck.
sentences.zh: 我的 Mobilette 有一个时髦的红色车架和一张超长的黑色皮座，后面有空间载一个脖子上围着围巾的女孩。

sentences.en: Like the Revel, it eased the stress of getting from point A to point B in a city.
sentences.zh: 像 Revel 一样，它减轻了在城市里从A点到B点的压力。

sentences.en: Unlike the Revel, it broke down constantly, teaching me new vocabulary words like idle jet, petcock, and lean oil mixture.
sentences.zh: 但与 Revel 不同的是，它经常抛锚，教会了我像“怠速喷嘴”、“燃油开关”和“混合油”这样的新词汇。

sentences.en: As one bumper sticker goes in the vintage scooter world, my other ride is 10 broken mopeds.
sentences.zh: 正如复古滑板车界的一句保险杠贴纸所说：我的另一辆座驾是10辆坏掉的轻便摩托车。

sentences.en: I wanted transportation, not a hobby.
sentences.zh: 我想要的是交通工具，而不是爱好。

sentences.en: And so I sold the Mobilette and went in search of something more reliable.
sentences.zh: 于是我卖掉了 Mobilette，开始寻找更可靠的东西。

sentences.en: A bicycle was too slow, an e-bike was too novel, an electric longboard was too embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 自行车太慢，电动自行车太新奇，电动滑板车太尴尬。

sentences.en: This was how a motorcycle started to feel like a practical choice.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么摩托车开始感觉像是一个实用的选择。

sentences.en: My Yamaha TW200 arrived in May 2021, after two months at sea in the pandemic supply chain.
sentences.zh: 我的雅马哈 TW200 在疫情供应链中海上漂泊了两个月后，于2021年5月到达。

sentences.en: Taking my bike out onto the streets, I quickly discovered that it was somewhat strange to view motorcycling as merely pragmatic.
sentences.zh: 骑着我的车上街，我很快发现，把骑摩托车仅仅视为实用是有点奇怪的。

sentences.en: Other motorcyclists threw up peace signs as they passed, suggesting to me that we had something in common.
sentences.zh: 其他摩托车手经过时会竖起和平手势，暗示我们有共同点。

sentences.en: Anywhere I wore my Kevlar jacket, friends harassed me with epithets like bad boy and asked if they could see my hog.
sentences.zh: 无论我在哪里穿上我的凯夫拉夹克，朋友们都会用“坏小子”之类的绰号骚扰我，并问能不能看看我的“大块头”。

sentences.en: The jacket and the helmet are for safety, I protested.
sentences.zh: “夹克和头盔是为了安全，”我抗议道。

sentences.en: The TW200 is a farm bike.
sentences.zh: “TW200 是一辆农用摩托车。”

sentences.en: They use it for herding animals.
sentences.zh: “他们用它来放牧动物。”

sentences.en: There were no livestock to herd in New York City.
sentences.zh: 纽约市没有牲畜可放。

sentences.en: And the more I objected, the more it gave the impression that I was in the throes of some latent crisis of masculinity.
sentences.zh: 我越是反驳，就越给人一种我正处于某种潜在的男性气质危机的感觉。

sentences.en: Still, I believe the motorcycle was its own thing.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我相信摩托车有它自己的意义。

sentences.en: Ten layers deep in sardonic detachment, I felt humiliated that a stranger might believe that I'd bought into the empty affectations of the biker.
sentences.zh: 在讽刺和超脱的深层，我感到羞愧，因为一个陌生人可能会认为我接受了骑手那些空洞的矫揉造作。

sentences.en: When strangers started flirting with me, saying nice bike and asking for a ride, I felt humiliated for them.
sentences.zh: 当陌生人开始跟我调情，说“好车”并要求搭便车时，我为他们感到羞愧。

sentences.en: How unselfaware must you be to stir at the sight of a motorcycle helmet?
sentences.zh: 看到摩托车头盔就心动，你得有多么缺乏自我意识？

sentences.en: Lucky for me, these questions were made irrelevant when my bike was stolen after just two months of riding.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，当我的摩托车在骑了仅仅两个月后被盗时，这些问题就变得无关紧要了。

sentences.en: The next morning, one building down with the super, I watched on a CCTV screen as two guys in hoodies with an angle grinder shucked my disc lock like a pistachio.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，我和楼管一起在监控屏幕上看到两个戴着连帽衫的家伙用角磨机像剥开心果一样撬开了我的碟刹锁。

sentences.en: The days after that were all labyrinthine bureaucracy and no open road.
sentences.zh: 接下来的日子全是繁琐的官僚程序，没有开阔的道路。

sentences.en: I called the insurance agent, who told me to call the cops, who told me to come down to the station, where they told me to go back home and call 911.
sentences.zh: 我打电话给保险代理人，他让我报警，警察让我去警局，警局又让我回家打911。

sentences.en: I went to notarize the claim form at the bank, where they told me to go to the pharmacy, whose notary only accepted cash, sending me right back to the bank.
sentences.zh: 我去银行公证索赔表，他们让我去药店，药店的公证员只收现金，又把我送回了银行。

sentences.en: Over that weekend, someone from the at Stolen Motorcycles NYC Instagram account saw my bike parked on the street in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 那个周末，纽约被盗摩托车 Instagram 账号上的人看到我的车停在布鲁克林的街上。

sentences.en: I texted the street address to my cop, who responded 10 days later to ask if I'd retrieved it.
sentences.zh: 我把街道地址发给了我的警察，他10天后回复问我是否已经找回了它。

sentences.en: Things went on like this for a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样持续了几周。

sentences.en: I kept a piece of yellow cardstock near my computer to record each step in the claim payout process.
sentences.zh: 我在电脑旁放了一张黄色卡纸，记录索赔支付过程的每一步。

sentences.en: At 45 steps, I added a second sheet.
sentences.zh: 到了第45步，我加了第二张纸。

sentences.en: Each new brush with bureaucracy made my motorcycle feel less like a machine and more like the nexus of paperwork streaMs.
sentences.zh: 每一次与官僚机构的接触，都让我的摩托车感觉不再是一台机器，而是一堆文书工作的核心。

sentences.en: By the time I left for Sturgis, I was 55 steps in, waiting for the DMV to mail a duplicate of a title I'd never received to begin with.
sentences.zh: 当我出发去斯特吉斯时，我已经进行了55步，还在等车管所邮寄一份我本来就没收到的所有权证书副本。

sentences.en: For a vehicle I no longer owned.
sentences.zh: 为了一个我早已不再拥有的车辆。

sentences.en: The whole biker lifestyle, which at first I'd written off, now seemed intriguing.
sentences.zh: 整个骑手生活方式，起初我对此不屑一顾，现在看来却很有趣。

sentences.en: And perhaps, even fun.
sentences.zh: 甚至，可能还有点好玩。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果可以免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: On the first official day of Sturgis, I woke up to a Daily Beast headline.
sentences.zh: 在斯特吉斯正式开始的第一天，我醒来看到《每日野兽》的头条新闻。

sentences.en: Sturgis rallied death cult pits nurses against panicked docs.
sentences.zh: “斯特吉斯拉力赛的死亡崇拜让护士与恐慌的医生对立。”

sentences.en: I scrolled through tweets from people on the coasts, predicting 10 days of public health indifference,
sentences.zh: 我浏览着来自沿海地区人们的推文，预测会有10天的公共卫生冷漠，

sentences.en: followed by widespread hospitalizations and an influx of Harleys for sale barely rode.
sentences.zh: 随后是广泛的住院治疗，以及大量几乎没怎么骑过的哈雷摩托车待售。

sentences.en: Many seized upon the number 700,000, a prediction, from where, of how many bikers were coming to Sturgis to gather en masse.
sentences.zh: 许多人抓住了“70万”这个数字，这是一个预测，不知道从哪来的，说有多少骑手会聚集到斯特吉斯。

sentences.en: This bothered me for two reasons.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到困扰，原因有二。

sentences.en: First, it stank of smug schadenfreude.
sentences.zh: 首先，它散发着一种沾沾自喜的幸灾乐祸气息。

sentences.en: Second, these people did not seem to understand the very basic facts of what Sturgis actually is.
sentences.zh: 其次，这些人似乎并不了解斯特吉斯到底是什么的基本事实。

sentences.en: Sturgis is not a single event so much as an unstoppable annual happening, like Christmas.
sentences.zh: 斯特吉斯与其说是一场单一的活动，不如说是一场不可阻挡的年度盛事，就像圣诞节一样。

sentences.en: It has no one true organizer.
sentences.zh: 它没有一个真正的组织者。

sentences.en: People are likely to show up every year, whether somebody endorses it or not.
sentences.zh: 无论是否有人背书，人们每年都可能会出现在这里。

sentences.en: The first Sturgis rally was held in 1938, when Clarence Pappy Howell, a local Indian brand motorcycle dealer, and the Jack Pine Gypsies, his motorcycle club, hosted a race.
sentences.zh: 第一届斯特吉斯集会于1938年举行，当时当地的印第安品牌摩托车经销商克拉伦斯·帕皮·豪威尔和他的摩托车俱乐部“松木吉普赛人”举办了一场比赛。

sentences.en: Nine riders were said to have attended.
sentences.zh: 据说有九名车手参加了比赛。

sentences.en: In the 1980s, the Sturgis rally grew from a sporting event to something more like a festival.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代，斯特吉斯集会从一项体育赛事发展成了更像节日的东西。

sentences.en: By then, it had established itself as basically a Harley-Davidson affair.
sentences.zh: 到那时，它已经确立了自己作为哈雷戴维森主场活动的地位。

sentences.en: One representative for the city of Sturgis told me that they used to string import bikes up in trees.
sentences.zh: 斯特吉斯市的一位代表告诉我，他们过去常把进口摩托车挂在树上。

sentences.en: Today, the rally has three main venues.
sentences.zh: 如今，集会有三个主要场地。

sentences.en: The city of Sturgis, population 7,020, the nearby city of Deadwood, from the television show, and the massive Buffalo Chip Campground, an RV park slash amphitheater.
sentences.zh: 斯特吉斯市（人口7020人）、电视节目中提到的附近城市戴德伍德，以及巨大的水牛芯片露营地（一个房车公园兼露天剧场）。

sentences.en: These entities host official events, rap rock concerts, bikini bike washes.
sentences.zh: 这些实体举办官方活动、说唱摇滚音乐会和比基尼洗车活动。

sentences.en: But because Sturgis is really about riding, attendees tend to spend their days out on the road,
sentences.zh: 但因为斯特吉斯的核心其实是骑行，所以参加者往往会花时间在路上，

sentences.en: stopping at towns along scenic highways, Custer, Hill City, Spearfish, and visiting Mount Rushmore.
sentences.zh: 在风景优美的公路沿线城镇停留，如卡斯特、希尔城、斯皮尔菲什，并参观拉什莫尔山。

sentences.en: City officials and the South Dakota Department of Transportation didn't seem to know where the number 700,000 came from.
sentences.zh: 市政府官员和南达科他州交通部似乎都不知道70万这个数字是从哪里来的。

sentences.en: The city's attendance count, calculated after the fact, would turn out to be closer to 550,000.
sentences.zh: 事后计算出的该市出席人数最终接近55万人。

sentences.en: I started my day in historic downtown Sturgis at the Harley-Davidson Rally Point,
sentences.zh: 我的一天是从历史悠久的斯特吉斯市中心的哈雷戴维森集会点开始的，

sentences.en: a handsome slate and iron plaza built in public-private partnership to commemorate 75 years of the rally.
sentences.zh: 这是一个漂亮的板岩和铁艺广场，是为纪念集会75周年而通过公私合营建造的。

sentences.en: A small crowd of press and industry types awaited a welcome message from the mayor.
sentences.zh: 一小群媒体和行业人士在等待市长的欢迎致辞。

sentences.en: The Budweiser Clydesdales clomped nearby.
sentences.zh: 百威克莱兹代尔马车在附近踏步而过。

sentences.en: The Budweiser girls adjusted their hair and fiddled with the belt loops of their cut-off denim shorts.
sentences.zh: 百威女郎们整理着头发，摆弄着她们牛仔短裤的腰带环。

sentences.en: At noon, the mayor of Sturgis took the stage, inviting his niece to sing the national anthem.
sentences.zh: 中午，斯特吉斯市长登上舞台，邀请他的侄女演唱国歌。

sentences.en: There was a message from the city council president, his sister, a welcome in Lakota from a Native American women's riding club,
sentences.zh: 市议会主席（他的妹妹）发表了讲话，一位美洲原住民女子骑行俱乐部的成员用拉科塔语表示欢迎，

sentences.en: a drink-responsibly message, a technical glitch, a thank you to all of the sponsors, and a prayer.
sentences.zh: 还有关于理性饮酒的提醒、技术故障、对所有赞助商的感谢以及一段祈祷。

sentences.en: Heavenly Father, Sovereign Lord, we appreciate the gift of faith and the blessings that we all have.
sentences.zh: 天父，至高无上的主，我们感谢信仰的恩赐以及我们所拥有的一切祝福。

sentences.en: We pray in times of turmoil and difficulty that we still understand that love is the answer and the greatest commandment of all.
sentences.zh: 我们祈祷在动荡和困难时期，我们仍能明白爱是答案，是所有诫命中最大的一条。

sentences.en: We thank you for two wheels, steel, the Black Hills, and this community.
sentences.zh: 我们感谢您赐予我们双轮、钢铁、黑山以及这个社区。

sentences.en: We pray that respect and love overcomes all, and that this rally is as great as it gets.
sentences.zh: 我们祈祷尊重和爱能战胜一切，祈祷这次集会能尽善尽美。

sentences.en: We pray for safety, and just thank you for what we have, Lord.
sentences.zh: 我们祈祷平安，并为主所赐予的一切感谢您。

sentences.en: In Jesus' name we pray.
sentences.zh: 我们奉耶稣的名祈祷。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 阿门。

sentences.en: Just beyond the plaza lies the heart of downtown Sturgis, an old west town with spacious streets and flat-faced frontier architecture.
sentences.zh: 广场外就是斯特吉斯市中心的心脏地带，那是一座拥有宽阔街道和扁平边疆建筑风格的旧西部城镇。

sentences.en: A few businesses are only open for the rally.
sentences.zh: 一些商家只在集会期间营业。

sentences.en: Others undergo a Clark Kentish costume change to squeeze a few bucks out of bikers passing through.
sentences.zh: 另一些则像克拉克·肯特一样变装，从路过的骑手身上榨取几块钱。

sentences.en: The Heartland Home Store, a Whirlpool retailer, becomes a souvenir shop.
sentences.zh: 心脏地带家居店，一家惠而浦零售商，变成了纪念品商店。

sentences.en: The parking lots along the main drag, Lizelle Street, spring forth with Harley demo rides, and vendors selling things like aftermarket seats enhance with space-age fluidized gel.
sentences.zh: 主干道利泽尔街沿线的停车场里，哈雷试驾活动如雨后春笋般涌现，还有摊贩在兜售诸如带有太空时代流体凝胶的售后座椅等商品。

sentences.en: Compared with other kinds of pop-up carnivals, Sturgis Rally hides the boundaries of its fantasy quite well.
sentences.zh: 与其他类型的快闪嘉年华相比，斯特吉斯集会很好地隐藏了其幻想的边界。

sentences.en: Or rather, it interlocks seamlessly with the year-round fantasy of the old west town that hosts it.
sentences.zh: 或者说，它与举办它的旧西部城镇常年存在的幻想无缝衔接。

sentences.en: Against the Black Hills, the Harley-as-horse metaphor feels naturalistic.
sentences.zh: 在黑山的映衬下，“哈雷即骏马”的隐喻显得非常自然。

sentences.en: There's a long history of dudes in the west putting up tents to hawk crap to other dudes.
sentences.zh: 在西部，男人们搭起帐篷向其他男人兜售垃圾有着悠久的历史。

sentences.en: I walked Lizelle from east to west, passing a line of bikers at a red light.
sentences.zh: 我从东向西走过利泽尔街，经过红绿灯前排队的一群骑手。

sentences.en: Despite the frontier ambiance, the mood in town was lawful that day.
sentences.zh: 尽管有边疆氛围，但那天镇上的气氛很守法。

sentences.en: Everyone abided the speed limit.
sentences.zh: 每个人都遵守限速。

sentences.en: Trashcans sponsored by Russ Brown motorcycle attorneys stood at five-foot intervals, dissuading against the crime of littering.
sentences.zh: 由拉斯·布朗摩托车律师事务所赞助的垃圾桶每隔五英尺就放一个，以劝阻乱扔垃圾的犯罪行为。

sentences.en: Save for the odd fit of brazen throttle revving, the bulk of the rebellion at Sturgis seemed to express itself via consumption.
sentences.zh: 除了偶尔出现的肆无忌惮的轰油门声，斯特吉斯大部分的反叛似乎都通过消费表现出来。

sentences.en: On the Merch Inside the Tents, the slogans formed a manifesto so whimsically uncivil, I can present only a representative abridgment.
sentences.zh: 在帐篷里的商品上，标语形成了一份如此异想天开且不文明的宣言，我只能展示一个代表性的摘要。

sentences.en: Been there, done that.
sentences.zh: 去过那儿，做过那事。

sentences.en: COVID sucks.
sentences.zh: 新冠烂透了。

sentences.en: Homosexuals are gay.
sentences.zh: 同性恋就是同性恋。

sentences.en: Helmet laws suck.
sentences.zh: 头盔法烂透了。

sentences.en: Hold my beer while I kiss your girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 帮我拿一下啤酒，我要去亲你的女朋友。

sentences.en: Joe and the hoe got to go.
sentences.zh: 乔和那个荡妇必须滚蛋。

sentences.en: Jane Fonda, American trader bitch.
sentences.zh: 简·方达，美国叛徒婊子。

sentences.en: A tour of duty lasts a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 服役一次，受用一生。

sentences.en: I'm not a vet, but I'm proud of them.
sentences.zh: 我不是退伍军人，但我为他们感到骄傲。

sentences.en: Loud pipes may save lives, but Jesus Christ saves souls.
sentences.zh: 响亮的排气管或许能拯救生命，但耶稣基督拯救灵魂。

sentences.en: Only two in all of history ever died for freedom all over the world.
sentences.zh: 历史上只有两个人为全世界的自由而死。

sentences.en: Jesus Christ and the American soldier.
sentences.zh: 耶稣基督和美国士兵。

sentences.en: Irish.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰人。

sentences.en: Latino.
sentences.zh: 拉丁裔。

sentences.en: Firefighter.
sentences.zh: 消防员。

sentences.en: LDS.
sentences.zh: 耶稣基督后期圣徒教会成员。

sentences.en: Certified nursing assistant.
sentences.zh: 认证护理助理。

sentences.en: GynecologiSt.
sentences.zh: 妇科医生。

sentences.en: I identify as a biker.
sentences.zh: 我的身份是骑手。

sentences.en: I will not be forced to learn a foreign language to accommodate illegals in my country.
sentences.zh: 我不会被迫学习外语来迁就我国的非法移民。

sentences.en: I heart boobies.
sentences.zh: 我爱胸部。

sentences.en: Nipples make me smile.
sentences.zh: 乳头让我微笑。

sentences.en: The more hair I lose, the more head I get.
sentences.zh: 我掉的头发越多，得到的口交就越多。

sentences.en: Bikers don't go gray, we turn chrome.
sentences.zh: 骑手不会变老，我们只会变成铬合金。

sentences.en: Waking up on my second day at Sturgis, the first thing I heard through the hotel window was the sound.
sentences.zh: 在斯特吉斯的第二天醒来，我透过酒店窗户听到的第一件事就是那种声音。

sentences.en: Usually a motorcycle engine is something that fades away into the distance.
sentences.zh: 通常摩托车引擎的声音会逐渐消失在远方。

sentences.en: At Sturgis, there is no Doppler effect.
sentences.zh: 但在斯特吉斯，没有多普勒效应。

sentences.en: No dwindling, petering, waning at all.
sentences.zh: 完全没有减弱、衰减或消退。

sentences.en: Before one bike passes, another appears.
sentences.zh: 一辆车还没走，另一辆又出现了。

sentences.en: Sustaining a gruff under current of noise, the city of Sturgis has branded as the roar.
sentences.zh: 斯特吉斯市维持着一种粗犷的噪音底色，并将其品牌化为“咆哮”。

sentences.en: The primary perpetrator of the roar is a class of Harley Davidson, officially known as a grand American touring motorcycle and unofficially known as a bagger.
sentences.zh: 这种咆哮的主要制造者是一类哈雷戴维森摩托车，官方称为“美式大型旅行摩托车”，非官方称为“行李箱摩托车”。

sentences.en: Baggers are designed for comfort on long rides across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 行李箱摩托车专为在美国长途骑行时的舒适性而设计。

sentences.en: interstate.
sentences.zh: 州际公路。

sentences.en: They take their name from the saddlebags attached to the hindquarters of the bike.
sentences.zh: 它们的名字来源于安装在摩托车后部的马鞍包。

sentences.en: The most well-known fans of baggers are retirees, many of whom probably first bought Harleys in the 80s.
sentences.zh: 行李箱摩托车最著名的粉丝是退休人员，他们中的许多人可能是在80年代第一次购买哈雷的。

sentences.en: Between 1983 and 1987, the Reagan administration imposed a steep tariff increase on foreign-made bikes with engines larger than 700cc.
sentences.zh: 1983年至1987年间，里根政府对发动机排量超过700cc的外国摩托车征收了高额关税。

sentences.en: This law sheltered Harley and provided an incentive to double down on making heavy bikes with big engines.
sentences.zh: 这项法律保护了哈雷，并提供了加倍制造大排量重型摩托车的动力。

sentences.en: You can imagine Harley now as trapped in a tortured feedback loop, in which bikes get bigger and customers get older, losing the brand both cachet and youth appeal.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象哈雷现在陷入了一个痛苦的反馈循环：摩托车变得越来越大，客户变得越来越老，导致品牌既失去了声望，也失去了对年轻人的吸引力。

sentences.en: The bagger is the logical outcome of this cycle.
sentences.zh: 行李箱摩托车是这个循环的逻辑结果。

sentences.en: An over-designed, lazy boy on the go, well-suited to the needs of the geriatric rider.
sentences.zh: 一款设计过度、移动中的懒人沙发，非常适合老年骑手的需求。

sentences.en: The most extreme model, the Tri-Glide Ultra Trike, is sometimes maligned as a mobility scooter.
sentences.zh: 最极端的型号，三轮滑翔超极版，有时被嘲讽为代步车。

sentences.en: Because Sturgis is a highway riding event, almost every bike I saw for rent was a bagger.
sentences.zh: 因为斯特吉斯是一场公路骑行活动，我看到的几乎每一辆出租摩托车都是行李箱摩托车。

sentences.en: In the days leading up to the trip, this had been a major source of consternation, as I worried the bagger would make me feel uncool,
sentences.zh: 在旅行前的几天里，这让我非常焦虑，因为我担心行李箱摩托车会让我感觉不够酷，

sentences.en: and then wondered if my desire to feel cool betrayed some belief in biker lore after all.
sentences.zh: 然后又怀疑我想要感觉酷的渴望是否终究背叛了某种骑手传说。

sentences.en: There on the ground at the rental desk, this set off a subsequent spiral,
sentences.zh: 在租赁柜台前，这引发了一连串的心理螺旋，

sentences.en: in which I asked myself, what was actually so wrong about engaging with a prefab form of cool to begin with?
sentences.zh: 我问自己，从一开始就参与一种预制的酷感到底有什么错？

sentences.en: Mostly, though, my misgivings were concrete.
sentences.zh: 不过，我的顾虑大多是具体的。

sentences.en: My stolen motorcycle weighed less than 300 pounds.
sentences.zh: 我偷来的摩托车重量不到300磅。

sentences.en: Many Harley baggers can exceed 800 pounds.
sentences.zh: 许多哈雷行李箱摩托车可以超过800磅。

sentences.en: And from the motorcycle safety course I'd taken to get my license, I retained just one mandate.
sentences.zh: 而且从我考取驾照时参加的摩托车安全课程中，我只记住了一条准则。

sentences.en: Don't drop the bike.
sentences.zh: 别让车倒了。

sentences.en: Dropping a lightweight bike is an annoyance, and, at most, a tragedy for your mirrors or gas tank.
sentences.zh: 轻型摩托车倒了只是件烦心事，顶多是后视镜或油箱的悲剧。

sentences.en: Dropping the bagger would be humiliating.
sentences.zh: 行李箱摩托车倒了会很丢人。

sentences.en: I'd need two strangers to help me pick it up.
sentences.zh: 我需要两个陌生人帮我把它扶起来。

sentences.en: The rental agent listened to my concerns, and matched me with the Harley Heritage Softtail, a thinking man's bagger with leather panniers,
sentences.zh: 租赁代理听了我的担忧，给我配了一辆哈雷遗产软尾，这是一款带有皮质侧包的“思考者”行李箱摩托车，

sentences.en: weighing in at a mincing and elegant 700 pounds.
sentences.zh: 重量为优雅的700磅。

sentences.en: My plan was to ride to Needle's Eye Tunnel, a destination and scenic photo op I'd found through the Sturgis Instagram hashtag.
sentences.zh: 我的计划是骑车去针眼隧道，这是一个我通过斯特吉斯Instagram标签发现的目的地和风景拍照点。

sentences.en: Squeezing the clutch and finding first gear, I rolled off the lot onto Highway 14A, passing the now-defunct world's largest grill, and turning onto Rochefort Road,
sentences.zh: 捏住离合器，挂上一档，我驶离停车场进入14A公路，经过现已倒闭的“世界最大烧烤架”，转入罗什福尔路，

sentences.en: a meandering route through the Black Hills National ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一条蜿蜒穿过黑山国家森林的路线。

sentences.en: The scenery was pinier and more romantic than the tree erotica of a Yankee candle jar.
sentences.zh: 这里的风景比扬基蜡烛罐上的树木情色画更具松木气息，也更浪漫。

sentences.en: The roads were sinuous and well-maintained, and instantly I understood the pleasure of riding in a place where motorcycles were not just tolerated, but corded.
sentences.zh: 道路蜿蜒且维护良好，我立刻明白了在一个摩托车不仅被容忍、而且被推崇的地方骑行的乐趣。

sentences.en: Back in New York, I'd only ever rode one curve, a potholed frontage next to Greenwood Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 在纽约，我只骑过一个弯道，那是格林伍德公墓旁边一条坑坑洼洼的辅路。

sentences.en: Here, there were only curves.
sentences.zh: 在这里，到处都是弯道。

sentences.en: At first, I worked them tentatively, and then in a flow of efficient momentum.
sentences.zh: 起初，我试探性地过弯，然后进入了一种高效动力的流动状态。

sentences.en: It's pretty much self-evident that riding a motorcycle is fun.
sentences.zh: 骑摩托车很有趣，这几乎是不言而喻的。

sentences.en: There's plenty of riding on motorcycle culture and motorcycle outlaws and biker symbolism, but seldom does an author feel the need to explicate
sentences.zh: 关于摩托车文化、摩托车亡命之徒和骑手象征意义的论述很多，但很少有作者觉得有必要解释

sentences.en: the literal baseline appeal of the pastime.
sentences.zh: 这种消遣最字面意义上的基本吸引力。

sentences.en: In the famed Harley ethnography,
sentences.zh: 在著名的哈雷民族志《消费亚文化》中，

sentences.en: Subcultures of Consumption,
sentences.zh: 约翰·W·舒滕和詹姆斯·H·麦克亚历山大确定了他们认为有助于摩托车骑行体验灵性的四个因素。

sentences.en: John W.
sentences.zh: 引用如下：与自然的亲近感增强、感官意识提高、引擎的咒语般跳动、对风险的持续感知以及全神贯注的心理专注。

sentences.en: Schutten and James H.
sentences.zh: 很快，他们的描述必须超越具体事物，因为他们将哈雷骑行比作“现代版的萨满魔法飞行体验”。

sentences.en: McAlexander identify four factors they believe contribute to the spirituality of the motorcycle riding experience.
sentences.zh: 在某些条件下，例如在大雾、大雪或大雨中，在夜晚荒凉的街道上，在沙漠公路上追逐海市蜃楼，或在风暴前沿，

sentences.en: Quote, the increased closeness to nature, the heightened sensory awareness, the mantric throbbing of the engine, the constant awareness of risk, and the co-commit and mental focus.
sentences.zh: 整个骑行体验看起来可能特别神奇或超凡脱俗。

sentences.en: Soon, their descriptions must transcend the concrete, as they liken Harley riding to, quote, a modern equivalent of the shamanic experience of magical flight.
sentences.zh: 到达罗什福尔时，

sentences.en: Under certain conditions, e.g. in fog, snow, or heavy rain, on deserted streets at night, pursuing mirages on a desert highway, or at the leading edge of a storm front,
sentences.zh: 人口8人，我确实感觉超出了现实。

sentences.en: the whole experience of riding can seem particularly magical or otherworldly.
sentences.zh: 乍一看，这个小镇显得有点破败。

sentences.en: Arriving in Rochefort,
sentences.zh: 再一看，我怀疑它看起来那样只是为了迎合骑手偶然发现破败小镇的白日梦。

sentences.en: Population 8, I certainly felt beyond reality.
sentences.zh: 我停好车，走进罗什福尔杂货店，它自称是“美国的小缩影”。

sentences.en: On first glance, the town appeared a bit run down.
sentences.zh: 在那里，我买了一张明信片和一杯饮料。

sentences.en: On second, I wondered if it only looked that way, to appeal to the biker daydream of stumbling across a run-down town.
sentences.zh: 山谷里的树木吸收了所有的声音。

sentences.en: I parked and stopped into the Rochefort General Store, which bills itself as the small of America.
sentences.zh: 在离开小镇的路上，我经过一个消防局的标志。

sentences.en: There, I bought a postcard and a drink.
sentences.zh: “安全驾驶，否则我们就能看到你裸体了。”

sentences.en: The trees in the valley absorbed all of the sound.
sentences.zh: 被这种古朴气息彻底陶醉的我，扫视了一下街道看是否有迎面而来的车辆，然后猛地转动车把掉头，希望能为Instagram拍张好照片。

sentences.en: On the way out of town, I passed a fire department sign.
sentences.zh: 在车倒下之前我就知道它要倒了，失控的感觉在胃里翻腾，随后是左侧大灯像玉米片一样碎裂的声音。

sentences.en: Drive safe, or we get to see you naked.
sentences.zh: 我的自尊心未受伤害，我从倒下的车上爬下来，试了几次想把它硬生生扶起来。

sentences.en: So thoroughly intoxicated by the quaintness, I scanned the street for oncoming cars, then whipped my handlebars into a U-turn, hoping to score for Instagram.
sentences.zh: 当尝试失败后，我傻傻地站在那里，头盔就像宇航服的鱼缸头罩一样。

sentences.en: I knew the bike was falling before it even fell, the loss of control registered in my stomach, followed by the sound of my left headlight, crunching like a corn chip.
sentences.zh: 十分钟后，三名骑自行车的人从附近的小径尽头出现。

sentences.en: Unharmed from my ego, I crawled off the fallen bike and tried a few times to deadlift it back to standing.
sentences.zh: 他们把车扶正，让我继续上路，大灯挂在残骸上摇摇欲坠。

sentences.en: When that failed, I stood there stupidly, my helmet like the fishbowl head of a spacesuit.
sentences.zh: 在神秘镇外某个地方，我拦住了一辆卡车，司机帮我把灯粘了回去。

sentences.en: Ten minutes later, a trio of bicyclists emerged from the head of a nearby trail.
sentences.zh: 那之后不久，手机信号中断了，我开始怀疑自己可能正在经历一场真正的冒险。

sentences.en: They set the bike upright and sent me on my way, headlight dangling by its entrails.
sentences.zh: 在前往针眼隧道的路上，我在两种现实之间来回切换。

sentences.en: Somewhere outside Mystic, I flagged down a trucker who helped me tape the light back on.
sentences.zh: 斯特吉斯，那个封闭的哈雷迪士尼乐园；以及斯特吉斯，一个充满真实事业和危险的场合。

sentences.en: Soon after that, cell service dropped out, and I started to suspect I might be on a real adventure.
sentences.zh: 虽然集会是一个有些分散的活动，但行程感觉相当预先确定，由快闪交通灯和市长带领的组织化团体骑行所强制执行。

sentences.en: Cruising along towards Needle's Eye Tunnel, I toggled back and forth between two realities.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这确实是开阔的公路。

sentences.en: Sturgis, the hermetic Harley Disneyland, and Sturgis, an occasion for real enterprise and danger.
sentences.zh: 南达科他州将旧金山的人口分散在约77000平方英里的土地上。

sentences.en: Though the rally was a somewhat decentralized event, the itinerary felt pretty predetermined, enforced by pop-up traffic lights and organized group rides led by the mayor.
sentences.zh: 而我确实陷入了困境且孤身一人，完全依赖陌生人的善意。

sentences.en: At the same time, this really was the open road.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，

sentences.en: South Dakota spreads the population of San Francisco across some 77,000 square miles.
sentences.zh: 斯特吉斯集会似乎过度推销了自己的冒险性。

sentences.en: And I really was in trouble and alone, fully reliant on the kindness of strangers.
sentences.zh: 摩托车本身并没有什么内在的政治性，至少，并不比其他任何东西更具政治性。

sentences.en: Still,
sentences.zh: 然而，市中心的商品似乎拼命想让我相信事实并非如此，即骑手不仅仅是一个业余爱好者，而是一个对抗各种敌人的警惕战士。

sentences.en: Sturgis rally seemed to oversell its own adventurousness.
sentences.zh: 第一，它散发着一种沾沾自喜的幸灾乐祸气息。

sentences.en: There is nothing inherently political about motorcycles, at least, not more than anything else.
sentences.zh: 第二，这些人似乎并不了解斯特吉斯到底是什么的基本事实。

sentences.en: And yet, the merchandise downtown seemed desperate to convince me otherwise, that the biker was not just a hobbyist, but a vigilant combatant against various enemies.
sentences.zh: 斯特吉斯与其说是一场单一的活动，不如说是一场不可阻挡的年度盛事，就像圣诞节一样。

sentences.en: Sometimes these were the usual foes, liberals, illegals,
sentences.zh: 有时这些是常见的敌人，自由派、非法移民，

sentences.en: Joe Biden, people who don't heart boobies.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登，还有那些不喜欢“我爱胸部”文化的人。

sentences.en: And behind all of this lurked the mythic outlaw biker, a boogeyman so bad to the bone that he could commit any sort of crime anywhere, at any moment.
sentences.zh: 而在这一切背后潜伏着神话般的亡命摩托车手，一个坏到骨子里的“怪物”，他随时随地都可能犯下任何罪行。

sentences.en: Nearly everyone I spoke to that weekend had some anecdote about how Sturgis used to be dangerous, or was still way more dangerous than you might think.
sentences.zh: 那个周末我交谈过的几乎每个人，都有关于斯特吉斯过去有多危险，或者现在依然比你想象中危险得多的轶事。

sentences.en: One man I met while walking downtown explained that there were FBI agents everywhere who would rip off their disguises at the first sight of Hell's Angels.
sentences.zh: 我在市中心散步时遇到的一名男子解释说，到处都是联邦调查局特工，他们一看到地狱天使帮就会撕掉伪装。

sentences.en: Outside some of the bars, there were signs that read, no colors, and I couldn't help feeling that the intended audience was people who were not in biker gangs themselves.
sentences.zh: 在一些酒吧外，挂着写有“禁止穿帮派背心”的牌子，我不禁觉得，这些牌子针对的其实并不是摩托车帮派成员自己。

sentences.en: Riding along, I thought about Harley and how its ultimate triumph of the brand was creating a mass fantasy in which men could role play as outlaws on weekends.
sentences.zh: 骑行时，我想到哈雷，想到它品牌最伟大的胜利，就是创造了一种大众幻想，让男人们可以在周末扮演亡命之徒。

sentences.en: Much could be said here of boomer decline, from easy rider to mortgaged homeowner and so on, but for me in that moment, such cynical truths did not feel so insidious.
sentences.zh: 关于婴儿潮一代的衰落，从《逍遥骑士》到背负房贷的房主等等，这里可以谈很多，但在那一刻，对我来说，这些愤世嫉俗的真相并没有那么阴险。

sentences.en: My bagger, though I hated it, opened up a space in which motorcycling could be many things at once, a nexus of paperwork streams, a symbol of a culture war waged on false grounds,
sentences.zh: 我的重型旅行摩托车，尽管我很讨厌它，却开辟了一个空间，让摩托车骑行可以同时成为许多事物，它是文书流的交汇点，是一场基于虚假理由发动的文化战争的象征，

sentences.en: the loophole through which I could transcend it all for a moment.
sentences.zh: 也是我能暂时超越这一切的漏洞。

sentences.en: Was it the shamanic experience of magical flight?
sentences.zh: 这是一种魔法飞行的萨满体验吗？

sentences.en: Or was I just driving fast and feeling cool?
sentences.zh: 还是我只是开得很快，感觉很酷？

sentences.en: As my phone caught some service,
sentences.zh: 当我的手机收到一点信号时，

sentences.en: Drake came over my AirPods.
sentences.zh: 德雷克的歌声从我的AirPods里传了出来。

sentences.en: I leaned into a curve and the myths that I detested.
sentences.zh: 我倾身过弯，也倾身投入了我所厌恶的那些神话中。

sentences.en: I was James Dean,
sentences.zh: 我是詹姆斯·迪恩，

sentences.en: DMX,
sentences.zh: DMX，

sentences.en: Che Guevara.
sentences.zh: 切·格瓦拉。

sentences.en: I was a bad boy, riding a nice hog.
sentences.zh: 我是一个骑着好摩托的坏小子。

sentences.en: Thankfully, no one I knew was there to see it.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，我认识的人没人在那儿看到这一幕。

sentences.en: A lot of people were there, though, pursuing the fantasy in their own way.
sentences.zh: 不过，确实有很多人在那里，以他们自己的方式追求着这种幻想。

sentences.en: We were a gang of bad boys on nice hogs, clogging the silly straw of Needle's Highway.
sentences.zh: 我们是一群骑着好摩托的坏小子，堵塞了针眼公路那狭窄的通道。

sentences.en: The tunnel appeared, first as a traffic jam, and then as a truck-sized aperture of light blasted through the face of the granite pinnacles.
sentences.zh: 隧道出现了，先是交通堵塞，然后是一个卡车大小的光孔，在花岗岩尖峰的表面炸开。

sentences.en: A teenager sat at the mouth in safety yellow, waving people through with a light-up baton.
sentences.zh: 一个穿着安全黄背心的少年坐在洞口，挥舞着发光的指挥棒引导人们通过。

sentences.en: I inched forward,
sentences.zh: 我缓慢前行，

sentences.en: steadying the bike.
sentences.zh: 稳住摩托车。

sentences.en: Finally, he waved me through.
sentences.zh: 终于，他挥手让我通过了。
